subject: Implement AMC REST client with idempotency and typed error codes
description:
Build `capo/transport/amc_client.py` — REST wrapper for `GET /messages/unread`, `POST /messages/send`, `POST /messages/mark_read`. Per §7.5 contract: every request includes `Authorization: Bearer $AMC_BEARER_TOKEN`, `X-Agent-ID: capo`, and `Content-Type: application/json`. Outbound `send` includes a freshly-generated UUIDv4 `Idempotency-Key`.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] `send(channel_id, text, reply_to_message_id=None, approval=None, idempotency_key=None)` posts per §7.5 contract; returns `{message_id, channel_id, status}`.
- [ ] `get_unread()` returns `list[AMCInboundEnvelope]` per §7.5 unread contract.
- [ ] `mark_read(message_ids)` returns `{marked_read, already_read}`; idempotent by `message_id`.
- [ ] Every outbound request sets `X-Agent-ID: capo` header.
- [ ] Typed exceptions per AMC error code: `RateLimited`, `PlatformAuth`, `ChannelNotFound`, `AttachmentTooLarge`, `ValidationError`, `AMCInternalError`.
- [ ] `RATE_LIMITED` is retried automatically honoring `Retry-After`; `PLATFORM_AUTH`, `CHANNEL_NOT_FOUND`, `ATTACHMENT_TOO_LARGE` are NOT retried.
- [ ] Transient 5xx and `RATE_LIMITED` retries on `unread` and `mark_read`.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Same `Idempotency-Key` does not produce duplicate user-visible messages on retry.
- [ ] `mark_read` repeated on already-read `message_id` succeeds as no-op.

_Error Handling:_
- [ ] Error response shape parsed per §7.5: `{ "error": { "code", "message", "retry_after_seconds"? } }`.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: each error code maps to its typed exception
• Unit: `Idempotency-Key` header generated per call
• Unit: `X-Agent-ID: capo` header present on all outbound calls
• Integration: `RATE_LIMITED` honors `Retry-After` and retries

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.2, 7.5, 9.1
